items.headline: Pump.fun Adds Pre-IPO Tokens to Launch Pairings
items.summary: Pump.fun now pairs new launches with eight PreStocks pre-IPO assets offering economic exposure, not shareholder rights. US persons are excluded.

items.headline: Lighter Launches BTC & ETH Binary Options
items.summary: Lighter's new Up/Down contracts pay 1 USDC to winners, are fully funded, and carry no leverage or liquidations — a fresh DeFi use case on Core.

items.headline: $STRK Sinks 38% as Starknet Rally Reverses
items.summary: $STRK gave back 38% in a week, though Starknet DeFi TVL fell only 5.3%. Voting on an independent Layer 1 runs until Oct. 22.

items.headline: THORChain Halts $ZEC Swaps After Vault Slash
items.summary: A bug slashed ~140 $RUNE from 18 node accounts, keeping $ZEC swaps paused on THORChain. The fix ships with the v3.21 upgrade around Oct. 23.

items.headline: Maple's $SYRUP Slides 24% Despite Buybacks
items.summary: $SYRUP underperformed BTC and ETH with a 24% weekly drop, even as Maple holds $2.71B TVL and doubled revenue-funded buybacks in September.
